release_metadata.title: BioTasks notebook pilot: bioframe motifs to peaks
release_metadata.description: A notebook-grounded computational biology task derived from a pinned bioframe tutorial, with source provenance and separate scientific/native validation evidence.
release_metadata.methodology: Convert the original pinned notebook to a script; GLM-5.3 with native high requested selects terminal exports, prepares the frozen offline environment, specifies and constructs the task. Independently authored controls, original-source coverage review and native Harbor oracle/no-op controls validate the task; a blind GLM attempt is recorded. Release requires source-bound evidence of seven completed autonomous stages and zero operator interventions. Effective served effort and cross-engine portability are not established.

gates: Exact actual input identities match reviewed notices frozen before native validation
Fresh scientific/source coverage and exact native task binding accepted
Owned public destination, managed-file replacement, original release preserved by immutable revision
Independent download and full release verification after publication
